landing_intro: Create an organizer account and a dedicated workspace for your mosque, community group or organization.
landing_note: For organizations bringing people together through participation and engagement.
landing_panel_intro: Set up your account, verify your email and save your organization’s details.
feature_account_copy: Sign up, verify your email and securely return to your account.
feature_workspace_copy: Choose a name, workspace address and timezone for your organization.
feature_return_copy: Sign in to view your organizations and their saved details.
landing_status: Available now: organizer accounts, workspaces, members and groups.
landing_cta_copy: Create your account, verify your email and make your workspace yours.
story_intro: Start with your organizer account and a dedicated workspace for your organization.
saved_benefit: Your workspace, saved for your next visit.
dedicated_space: A dedicated space for your organization.
sign_out_description: You’ll need to sign in again to access your organization. Your saved workspaces will stay safe. Unsaved changes will be lost.
organizations_intro: Choose a saved workspace or create a new one.
signup_intro: Create your organizer account, then set up your organization.
signin_intro: Sign in to your saved organization workspaces.
verify_intro: Verify your email before creating an organization.
recovery_intro: Recover your account with a code sent to your email.
adult_organizer: I’m an adult authorized to set up and manage this organization.
setup_scope: Organizers can set up a workspace and manage private member records, groups and staff access.
setup_intro: Choose your organization’s name, a unique workspace address and its timezone.
slug_help: A unique name: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
authorized_organizer: I am an adult authorized to create and manage this organization.
no_payment: No payment is required to create your workspace.
workspace_saved: Your organization is saved and stays available when you sign in again.
error_description: Your request could not be completed.
replace_password_description: You will use the new password to sign in. Confirm to replace the current password.
discard_setup_description: Your unsaved organization details will be lost.
error_account_unavailable: Account services are unavailable. Please try again.
error_adult: Confirm that you are an adult organizer.
error_code: That code could not be verified.
error_authorized: Confirm that you are an adult authorized to manage this organization.
notice_account_created: Account created. Use Send a new code to verify your email.
notice_check_inbox: Check your inbox for a verification code.
notice_verified: Email verified. Sign in to continue.
notice_verified_continue: Email verified. Sign in if needed to continue.
notice_recovery: If your email belongs to an account, a recovery code has been sent.
notice_password_updated: Password updated. Sign in to continue.
notice_code_sent: A new verification code has been sent.
error_slug: Workspace address must be 3–48 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens.
error_refresh: Refresh the setup page and try again.
error_taken: That workspace address is already taken. Try another.
error_rate_limit: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
error_workspace_unavailable: Workspace storage is not configured yet.
error_service: Account service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
error_expired_code: This code has expired. Request a new code.
error_existing_email: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
page_description: Create your organizer account and your organization’s own workspace with Himmah Hub.
offline_description: Connect to the internet to sign in or open your organization. Your account information is never stored for offline access.
install_description: Add Himmah to your home screen for easy access. An internet connection is needed to manage your account.
install_ios: On iPhone or iPad, open Himmah in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen and Add.
install_other: Open your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen, if available.
error_password_short: Use a password with at least 12 characters.
error_password_long: Use a password with no more than 128 characters.
error_auth_network: We couldn’t reach the account service. Check your connection and try again.
error_verification_required: Verify your email before signing in. Choose the unverified account option to request a code.
directory_roster_help: Private roster records, separate from login accounts. Use a nickname and follow your organization’s consent process.
directory_groups_help: Organize members into groups. A member can belong to more than one group.
directory_staff_help: Manage verified organizer access. Invitations are bound to one email address.
directory_no_matches: Try a different search or filter.
directory_get_started: Add your first record using the button above.
directory_archive_description: Change the archive status of {name}? History and group assignments will be kept.
directory_remove_description: Remove {name} from {group}? The member’s roster record will stay.
directory_access_description: This changes access to your organization. Existing saved records will be kept.
directory_invite_help: Create a private invitation link for an adult staff member. It expires after seven days and requires a verified account with the matching email.
directory_consent: I am authorized to keep this record and have any required permission or consent.
directory_discard_description: Your unsaved form changes will be lost.
directory_choose_group: Choose an active group for this member.
directory_share_help: Send this link yourself to the intended person. It is shown only now; create a new invitation if you lose it. No email has been sent automatically.
directory_copy_manual: Select and copy the link manually.
directory_join_help: Accept only an invitation you were expecting. Your verified account email must match the invitation.
directory_volunteer_access: Your volunteer access is active. Directory administration is reserved for owners and administrators.
directory_end: You’ve reached the end of this list.
directory_page_error: The next records could not be loaded. Your current list is still available.
directory_invalid_input: Check the entered details and try again.
directory_invalid_name: Use a display name of 2–80 characters.
directory_invalid_cursor: This list changed. Refresh it and try again.
directory_not_found: This workspace or record is unavailable.
directory_forbidden: You do not have permission to manage this directory.
directory_consent_required: Confirm your authorization and the required permission or consent.
directory_conflict: This record changed or access was removed. The list has been refreshed; review it before trying again.
directory_duplicate_name: That group name is already in use. Choose another.
directory_invalid_invitation: This invitation is invalid, expired, revoked or belongs to a different email. Ask the organizer for help.
directory_rate_limit: Too many changes. Wait a minute and try again.
directory_service: The directory is unavailable. Please try again.
switch_organization_help: Choose the organization you want to work with.
directory_group_members_help: Members of this group. To add someone, open Members and choose Add to group.
activities_help: Organize activities and schedule their sessions.
activities_cancel_help: Archive “{name}”? New sessions cannot be added. Existing sessions and their details stay unchanged.
activities_form_help: Set the activity details and audience, then schedule sessions. Changes apply to new sessions.
directory_activity_time: Choose valid start and end times, at most seven days apart. Times that are skipped or repeated by daylight saving cannot be used.
activities_audience_help: Select up to 20 groups. Group choices apply to new sessions; existing sessions keep their audience.
directory_activity_audience: Choose everyone or 1–20 active groups from this organization.
sessions_form_help: Schedule a future session. It keeps a copy of the activity details and audience.
sessions_edit_help: Change this future session’s time or location. Other sessions stay unchanged.
sessions_snapshot_help: These details and this audience were saved for this session.
sessions_past_help: The session’s schedule and details are read-only once it starts.
sessions_cancel_help: Cancel this session? Its details and cancellation reason will stay in the history.
directory_session_future: Choose a start time in the future. Sessions that have already started cannot be edited.
attendance_help: Record session attendance. Unmarked members are not counted as absent.
attendance_empty: No members match this roster view.
attendance_outside: Outside the current audience · saved record
attendance_reason_help: Required when changing saved attendance. Keep personal or sensitive circumstances out of the reason.
attendance_correct_help: Update saved attendance for the selected members? The previous values and your reason will stay in the history.
attendance_failed: {count} need review. The roster has been refreshed; review those members before trying again.
attendance_uncertain: The save is not confirmed. Retry this same request to check its result.
attendance_leave_help: This save has not been confirmed. It may already have reached the server. Retry to check the result, or leave and review the roster when you return.
attendance_not_started: Check-in opens when this session starts. Refresh the roster then.
attendance_cancelled: This session is cancelled. Attendance can only be viewed.
attendance_access: You do not have permission to manage this session’s attendance.
directory_attendance_not_started: Check-in is not open yet. Refresh when the session starts.
directory_attendance_cancelled: This session was cancelled. Its attendance is read-only.
directory_attendance_key_conflict: This request key was already used for a different save. Refresh and review the roster.
attendance_conflict: Changed since it was loaded. Review the latest status.
attendance_ineligible: Not currently eligible for a new attendance record.
directory_choose_members: Choose up to 50 active members. Members already in this group cannot be selected.
points_help: Record contributions manually and review earned points. Attendance points depend on each session’s saved rule.
points_review_help: Award {amount} points each to {count} members ({total} points in total).
points_correct_help: Set the corrected value for this award. A linked adjustment preserves the original and records your reason. Use 0 to reverse the award.
points_leave_help: This save has not been confirmed and may have reached the server. Retry to check its result, or review member histories before creating another award.
points_conflict: Not saved: this award changed. Reopen it to review.
directory_points_amount: Choose a whole point amount from 1 to 10,000 (0 is allowed for a correction).
directory_points_date: Choose a valid contribution date from 2000 until now.
directory_points_key_conflict: This request key was already used for different data. Close the form and review the member history before continuing.
periods_help: Review points and recorded attendance within a date range. Overlapping periods do not create extra points.
periods_form_help: Dates include whole days in the saved timezone. Editing an open period recalculates its report without changing source records.
periods_close_help: Freeze this report permanently? Member and group names, membership, points and attendance will be saved as they are now. Later records and corrections will still update their source histories, but will not change this report. You cannot edit or reopen this period.
periods_closed_help: Frozen report. Later records, corrections and roster changes are not included.
periods_live_help: Live report using current group membership. Attendance counts recorded states for sessions starting in this period; missing records are not treated as absences.
periods_group_help: Members may belong to several groups. Do not add group totals together.
periods_leave_help: This save has not been confirmed and may have reached the server. Retry with this form to check its result before creating another period.
directory_period_dates: Choose real dates from 2000–2100, with the last day on or after the first day.
directory_period_closed: This period is closed. Its saved report cannot be edited.
earning_enable: Award points for attendance in new sessions
earning_help: Optional. Use 1–10,000 whole points. Changes apply only to sessions created afterward; existing sessions keep their saved rule.
earning_preview_help: Check each member’s attendance and linked point change before saving. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
earning_preview_failed: Some members cannot be saved. Review the outcomes below; eligible members can still be saved.
directory_earning_amount: Choose 0 for attendance-only, or 1–10,000 whole points for being present.
directory_earning_review_required: Review and confirm the linked point changes before saving attendance.
points_managed: Not saved: correct this award through attendance
access_help: Assign a group or activity and allow attendance, manual awards, or both. Access applies only while the volunteer and target are active.
access_attend_help: Includes the linked point grants, reversals and restorations required by the saved session rule.
access_award_help: Allows new manual awards within this scope. Only owners/admins can correct manual awards.
access_scope_help: A group assignment follows its current members. An activity assignment covers its audience; an activity for everyone includes all organization members.
access_revoke_help: Remove this volunteer’s permissions for this assignment? Existing attendance, points and audit history are preserved.
access_reduce_help: Remove the permissions you unchecked? New requests will use the reduced access. Existing records are preserved.
access_staff_change: Automatically revoked after a staff role/access change
access_work_help: Only members in your manual-points assignments appear here. Histories and totals show your own manual awards and attendance awards you are permitted to manage.
access_no_work: You have no active manual-points assignment. Ask an organizer to assign your work.
access_leave_help: This save is unconfirmed and may have reached the server. Retry this form or review assignments before creating another grant.
directory_access_duplicate: This volunteer already has an active assignment for this target. Edit that assignment instead.
directory_access_volunteer: Choose a current volunteer in this organization.
rewards_help: Recognize engagement with staff-managed rewards. Earned points stay in the engagement history.
rewards_stock_help: Leave blank for unlimited stock. Total stock includes reserved and handed-out rewards.
rewards_form_help: Changes apply to future redemptions. Existing reservations keep their saved name and point cost.
rewards_reserve_help: Reserve this reward for {name}? {amount} points will be reserved until handout. You can cancel a pending reservation with a reason.
rewards_fulfil_help: Confirm that {name} received this reward. Reserved points become spent points. This handout is final in the app.
rewards_cancel_help: Release the reserved points and stock? The original reservation and cancellation reason remain in history.
rewards_wallet_help: Redemptions never change earned points. Later point corrections can reduce the available balance, even below zero.
rewards_deficit: This member has spent or reserved more than their current earned points. New reservations are blocked until the balance recovers.
rewards_archive_help: Hide this reward from new reservations? Existing reservations and handouts remain available.
rewards_leave_help: This request may have reached the server. Retry it here or review the history before submitting another reservation.
directory_reward_stock: Stock must be blank or a whole number from 0 to 1,000,000.
directory_reward_stock_used: Total stock cannot be lower than the number already reserved or handed out.
directory_reward_balance: This member no longer has enough available points. Refresh the member list.
directory_reward_out_of_stock: This reward is out of stock.
directory_reward_archived: This reward is archived and cannot be reserved.
directory_reward_member_archived: Archived members cannot reserve new rewards.
directory_reward_reason: Give a cancellation reason of 1–300 characters.
rewards_restore_help: Make this reward available for new reservations again?
participant_access_help: Link this member to a private account using an email-bound invitation. Staff permissions are separate.
participant_invite_help: The recipient must verify the invited email address. The link expires after seven days. No invitation email is sent automatically.
participant_consent: I verified the recipient’s identity and recorded all required consent, including guardian consent where applicable, following our organization’s policy.
participant_disconnect_help: Remove this account’s access to this member and invalidate pending invitations? Points, reservations and audit history are preserved. A new invitation will be required to reconnect.
participant_revoke_invite_help: Invalidate this invitation link? It will no longer connect an account to this member.
participant_share_help: Share this link privately with the intended recipient. Copy it before closing; it cannot be recovered later. If needed, revoke it and create a new invitation.
participant_leave_help: This request may have reached the server. Retry it here or review access history before creating another invitation.
participant_join_help: Use the email address your organizer invited. Connecting gives you private access to your own progress and available rewards.
participant_points_help: Your point entries are shown below. Staff-only notes are kept private. Corrections are included in your earned balance.
participant_rewards_help: Choose a reward and redeem your points. Show your coupon to an organizer to collect it.
participant_history_help: Your reserved, handed-out and cancelled rewards. Contact an organizer if you need help.
participant_event_member_archived: Access removed when member was archived
directory_participant_consent: Confirm recipient identity and all required consent before inviting.
directory_participant_linked: This member or account already has an active connection in this organization.
directory_participant_pending: There is already an active invitation for this member. Revoke it before creating another.
directory_participant_staff_conflict: An account cannot have staff and participant access in the same organization. Ask your organizer which account to use.
manage_intro: Organization tools, reports and team access, organized in one place.
manage_periods_help: Review engagement over a period and close final reports.
manage_staff_help: Manage the people who help run your organization.
manage_invites_help: Invite organizers and manage pending staff invitations.
manage_access_help: Choose which groups and activities volunteers can manage.
manage_organization_help: View workspace details, timezone and your role.
profile_intro: Your account, language and app preferences.
coupons_intro: Your reserved rewards, ready to collect.
coupons_empty: No unused coupons yet. Redeem a reward to get started.
coupon_claim_help: These points will be reserved for this reward. They become spent when an organizer hands it over. You can cancel an unused coupon to release the points.
coupon_cancel_help: Cancel this unused coupon? Its reserved points and stock will become available again. A collected reward cannot be cancelled.
coupon_show_help: Show this QR code to an organizer when collecting your reward. Keep the coupon private.
coupon_used: This reward has already been collected. The coupon cannot be used again.
coupon_cancelled: This coupon was cancelled. Its reservation has been released.
coupon_unavailable: This coupon is not available. Ask an organizer for help.
coupon_collect_help: Scan a coupon or paste its link/code. Review the reward and participant before confirming the handover.
coupon_collect_review: Hand “{reward}” to {person}? This permanently uses the coupon and finalizes the reserved points.
coupon_no_self_collect: Another organizer must collect this reward for you.
coupon_camera_help: Point your camera at the participant’s coupon.
coupon_camera_error: Camera scanning is unavailable or permission was denied. Paste the coupon link or code instead.
coupon_uncertain: The response is uncertain. Retry this same action to check its result without creating a duplicate. Leaving does not undo a request that reached the server.
directory_coupon_invalid: This coupon code or link is not valid.
directory_coupon_org: This coupon belongs to another organization. Switch organizations before scanning it.
challenge_selected_groups: Selected groups: {count}. Select at least one.
challenge_draft_help: Save a draft, then publish it when ready. Publishing locks the points, dates, instructions and eligible groups.
challenge_publish_help: Make this challenge visible to eligible participants? Its settings will be locked. Each person can earn its points once.
challenge_archive_help: Stop new submissions and direct completions. Existing submissions and points remain, and pending submissions can still be reviewed.
challenge_submit_help: Tell an organizer you have completed this challenge. Points are awarded only after approval. Do not include sensitive or private information.
challenge_feedback_help: The participant can read this note. Give a clear, respectful explanation. A note is required when asking for another attempt or recording a completion directly.
challenge_withdraw_help: Withdraw this pending submission? No points have been awarded. You can try again while the challenge is open.
challenge_review_confirm: Confirm this decision for {person}? Approval awards {points} points once. Completed awards can be corrected from the member’s point history.
challenge_manage_help: Create opportunities to learn, help and take part. Review completions before awarding points.
challenge_personal_help: Choose a challenge, take part and send your completion for review.
challenge_not_open: This challenge is not open for new submissions.
challenge_not_eligible: Your current group membership does not allow a new submission. Your earlier submission remains available.
challenge_other_reviewer: Another organizer must review your submission.
challenge_uncertain: The result is uncertain. Retry the same request to check it safely. Leaving does not undo a request that reached the server.
directory_challenge_closed: This challenge is not open for new submissions. Refresh to see its current state.
challenge_points_corrected: The original award was {points} points. An organizer has corrected it in the point history.
notifications_help: Updates for this organization. Open an item to see the details.
notifications_empty: You’re all caught up. New updates will appear here.
notification_challenge_feedback: There is feedback on your challenge submission.
notification_reward_pending: A reward reservation is waiting for collection.
push_help: Receive private, generic alerts on this device for updates across your organizations. Names, notes, points and coupon codes stay inside Himmah.
push_enabled: Push notifications are enabled on this device.
push_disabled: Push notifications are off on this device.
push_unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. You can still read updates here.
push_ios: On iPhone or iPad, add Himmah to your Home Screen, then open the installed app to enable push notifications.
push_denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser or device settings, then try again.
push_service: Push notifications could not be updated. Check your connection and try again.
push_not_configured: Push notifications are temporarily unavailable. Your in-app notifications still work.
push_conflict: This device is linked to another account, or your account has reached the device limit. Disable push for the other account or device first.
push_disable_description: This device will stop receiving alerts. Your in-app notifications and other devices are unchanged.
push_all_description: Stop push alerts on every device signed in to this account. In-app notifications remain available.
push_device_hint: Each device needs permission separately. Delivery depends on your browser, connection and device settings.
push_alert: You have a new notification. Open Himmah to view it.
futsal_app_help: Run clubs, teams, training and simulated seasons.
futsal_apps_help: Choose an app for your organization. Hub works independently.
futsal_intro: Configure seasons, assign teams and follow the game.
futsal_empty: No seasons in this view yet.
futsal_prize_help: Describe what organizers will recognize. No points are spent and no rewards are issued by this setup.
futsal_mode_help: Club Manager gives each participant a club. In Team Play, participants develop their own player in a shared team.
futsal_fillers: Each team has five starters. Equal virtual teammates fill any remaining places.
futsal_calendar_help: Training is planned one hour before the first match, then at the chosen cadence through preparation and, optionally, between rounds. Times follow the season timezone.
futsal_bonus_growth: Extra growth when the bonus succeeds
futsal_points_help: All authorized Hub earning sources count under the same capped rules. Points are measured for training, never spent or added to the football table. Quizzes are optional.
futsal_benefit: {points} Hub points: {chance}% chance of extra growth.
futsal_tiebreak: League order: points, goal difference, goals scored, then shared placing.
futsal_knockout_help: Single elimination, byes where needed, and penalties to resolve a tied match. The saved draw is stable across refreshes.
futsal_remove_help: Remove this draft entry and its assignments. Hub members and points are preserved.
futsal_cancel_help: Keep the history but stop using this setup. Locked settings and assignments stay recorded.
futsal_lock_help: Freeze these rules, entrants and schedule in one snapshot. They cannot be edited afterward. Training and match execution are separate from this setup step.
futsal_locked_help: Rules, entrants and schedule are locked. Open Play to activate the season or follow its progress.
futsal_draft_help: Review the settings, fill every entry and check the schedule before locking setup.
futsal_none_entries: Add your first club or team. Each participant can enter this season once.
futsal_uncertain: The result is not confirmed yet. Retry sends the same request safely. Leaving may require checking the saved season before making another change.
directory_futsal_settings: Check the season settings and whole-number limits.
directory_futsal_dates: Preparation must precede the first match, and the deadline must be later, within 180 days.
directory_futsal_roster: Club Manager needs one participant and a squad of five or seven. Team Play needs two to five participants per five-a-side team.
directory_futsal_growth: The starting rating must be below the ceiling. Guaranteed and bonus growth must fit the growth cap; the chance step must fit the chance cap.
directory_futsal_standings: Win points must exceed draw points, and draw points must be at least loss points.
directory_futsal_calendar: The rounds must fit before the deadline, with no more than 128 training sessions. Extend the deadline or adjust the cadence.
directory_futsal_preparation: Allow at least one hour of preparation before the first match.
directory_futsal_entries: Fill exactly the configured number of clubs or teams before locking setup.
directory_futsal_member: Check that every entry has the required number of active organization members.
directory_futsal_assigned: A selected participant already belongs to another entry in this season.
directory_futsal_roster_change: Remove incompatible draft entries before changing the mode, team size or entry count.
directory_futsal_locked: This season setup is locked or cancelled and cannot be edited.
directory_futsal_future: The engagement preparation window must still be in the future when setup is locked. Update the draft dates.
futsal_replace_members_help: Update this draft entry’s participants. Hub member records and points are preserved.
futsal_growth_target: Growth applies to one attribute of one player per participant and training window, with the rating ceiling enforced.
game_conversion: Every {step} points adds {chance} percentage points to the bonus chance, up to {cap}%.
game_activate_help: Create equal-strength squads from the locked roster. Rules remain frozen. Training and rounds can then be processed when due.
game_advance_help: Save the next due training or match round. This result is final and cannot be rerolled.
game_lock_first: Lock the season setup before activating gameplay.
game_wait: The next event is not due yet. This page checks again automatically.
game_lineup_help: The first five players form the fixed balanced lineup. Manager training rotates through the full squad; Team Play trains each participant’s own player. Virtual fillers do not receive engagement growth. Tactics and lineup changes are not available in this version.
game_cutoff_help: Points and corrections count in the first training window after both their activity time and recording time. Late records roll forward; completed training never changes. Negative net points are clamped to zero for that window.
game_not_due: This event is not due yet.
directory_game_not_due: This event is not due yet.
